statement.task: Port the remaining ~19 rules against the proven v3 rule contract (Rule ABC + declared altitudes + dispatcher + finding ontology). Verdicts: complexity.{cognitive,combinatorial,volume,density}, coupling(CBO), inheritance.{depth=DIT,children=NOC}, hidden_mutators, magic_literals, sentinels, god_module, escape_hatches, redundancy, duplication, rigidity, uselessness, runts, hotspots, orphans, deps(cycles). Lexical as observations/batteries (NOT primitive-threshold rules): stutter, verbosity, hammers, sprawl, imposters, slackers, lexical_dispersion. Each ports one at a time; the measurement already lives on the component views (oracle-verified) — the rule is only threshold-check + emission.
statement.source_note: Slice intentionally shipped 3 representative rules (one per ontology cell) to prove the contract before bulk porting; remaining rules tracked here per goal DONE-WHEN.
